title: Sample Preparation for Single Nuclei Sequencing of Brain
author: Anna Martinez Casals
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.v44e8yw

steps.title: Tissue Preparation and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Prepare the brain tissue and homogenize it using a chilled Dounce homogenizer.

substeps.instruction: Place a Petri dish on dry ice, transfer the tissue, and cut it using a chilled scalpel.
Transfer the tissue into a precooled Dounce homogenizer (Wheaton, cat# 357538) and keep it on ice throughout the protocol.
Homogenize the tissue with five strokes of the loose pestle, followed by 10–15 strokes of the tight pestle.

steps.title: Initial Filtration and Pelleting
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenate and centrifuge to isolate nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Filter the homogenate through a BD Falcon tube with a cell strainer cap (Corning, cat# 352235).
Transfer the volume to a chilled 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge at 1000 rcf for 00:08:00 at 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant without disrupting the nuclei pellet.

steps.title: Myelin Removal
steps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei and treat with Myelin Removal Beads II.

substeps.instruction: Add 1800 µL nuclei wash and resuspension buffer to the pellet and gently pipette mix 8-10 times using a regular-bore pipette tip.
Add 200 µL Myelin Removal Beads II to the resuspended nuclei.
Mix with a wide-bore pipette tip (do not vortex).
Incubate for 00:15:00 at 4 °C.

steps.title: Column Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare LS columns for magnetic separation.

substeps.instruction: Place LS columns in the magnetic field of a MACS separator (QuadroMACS Separator, cat# 130-090-976; MACS MultiStand, cat# 130-042-303).
Rinse the columns with 3 mL LS Column Calibration Buffer each.

steps.title: Nuclei Dilution and Washing
steps.instruction: Dilute the nuclei suspension and perform a wash step.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the nuclei suspension with 10 mL Nuclei Wash and Resuspension buffer using a 10 ml serological pipette and gently pipette mix 5 times.
Centrifuge at 500 rcf for 00:10:00 at 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant without disrupting the nuclei pellet.
Add 2 mL Nuclei Wash and Resuspension buffer.

steps.title: Magnetic Separation
steps.instruction: Pass the nuclei through the prepared LS columns.

substeps.instruction: Apply 1 mL nuclei suspension into each column.
Wash each column with 1 mL Nuclei Wash and Resuspension buffer.
Collect the effluent into two 5ml Eppendorf tubes.

steps.title: Effluent Recovery and Pooling
steps.instruction: Concentrate and pool the nuclei from the column effluent.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the two vials with nuclei at 500 rcf for 00:05:00 at 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant from both vials without disrupting the pellet.
Add 500 µL Nuclei Wash and Resuspension buffer to each vial.
Pool both resuspended nuclei into a new pre-chilled 1.5 ml Eppendorf.

steps.title: Final Wash and Buffer Exchange
steps.instruction: Perform a final centrifugation and resuspension in homogenization buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1000 rcf for 00:08:00 at 4 °C.
Aspirate the supernatant (~1,000 μl) and gently resuspend the pellet in 250 μl of homogenization buffer.

steps.title: Iodixanol Gradient Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the iodixanol dilution mix (IDM) and dilutions and place them on ice.

steps.title: Aggregate Removal
steps.instruction: Strain the mixture through a BD Falcon tube with a cell strainer cap to remove remaining aggregates and place on ice.

steps.title: Iodixanol Density Gradient Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Purify nuclei using an iodixanol gradient.

substeps.instruction: Gently mix the nuclei with 250 μl of 50% (vol/vol) iodixanol.
Add 500 μl of 29% iodixanol to a new Eppendorf tube.
Slowly layer 500 μl of the nuclei mixture over the 29% iodixanol.
Centrifuge at 13,500 rcf for 00:20:00 at 4 °C.
Remove and discard the supernatant without disrupting the nuclei pellet.
Resuspend the final pellet in 60 µL Nuclei Wash and Resuspension buffer.
